title: Vietnam Aquaculture Water Quality Monitor
thesis: Snowflake turns daily pond probe data from a fictional aquaculture group's Vietnam farms (intensive shrimp ponds, super-intensive shrimp raceways, pangasius ponds, shrimp hatcheries and recirculating nurseries) into in-band water quality KPIs, 7-day event-risk scores, ammonia anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: In-band probe readings, water quality events, alarms per 1,000 parameter checks and probe readings for 30 farms across 6 Vietnam cities.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it traces back to farm-day rows and the probe readings behind them.
The out-of-band chart shows which event causes push the most readings outside the dissolved oxygen, pH, temperature, salinity or ammonia band.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of water quality KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which farms are likely to have the next water quality event?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each farm's probability of a water quality event in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags total ammonia outliers per farm, and the forecast projects network-wide probe-reading volume for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: How ready is the aeration behind those risks?

talking_points: Aeration uptime and equipment readiness (paddlewheel aerators, air blowers, water pumps, backup generators and dissolved oxygen probes) frame the response capacity.
PM compliance against in-band probe readings by farm shows where maintenance discipline and water quality move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, water quality event, cause and risk tables only.
show: PM compliance vs in-band probe readings
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a pond probe raises an ammonia alarm right now?

talking_points: Live pond probe readings (total ammonia in mg/L, aerator load) land in RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY, from the simulator or from AWS IoT Core through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs ALARM readings with an SOP hint and the farm's current risk band, then emails the shift technician.
tabs.call_out: From alarm to action in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over synthetic water quality SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (IoT Core, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
